facts.accidental_damage: Included for buildings, not for contents

wording.Section 3 — General exclusions: Loss or damage caused by flood is excluded unless Flood Cover is shown in the schedule.
wording.Section 1 — Buildings: Accidental damage to fixed glass and sanitary ware is covered.
wording.Section 2 — Contents: Contents are covered against fire, theft and escape of water. No single item is covered for more than the single item limit shown in the schedule.
wording.Section 4 — Claims conditions: You must tell us about any incident which may lead to a claim within 30 days.
